Interim FORGE projections until native forecasts go live: each player's latest FORGE v2 daily line (runs 2026-11-15 to 2026-11-22) stands in for his remaining games; 10 of 32 teams covered.
1 FORGE runs in the last week cannot prove they excluded third-party fantasy projections, so they are withheld; players covered only by them get no forecast.
Penalty minutes, plus-minus, shorthanded points, game-winning goals and faceoffs are season per-game rates (this season plus half of last, pulled toward league rates), not FORGE projections.

Future games move each FORGE line to that game's opponent with FORGE's team-strength adjustment (team xG for and against, 32 teams, last season blended in as 20 games), plus FORGE's home-ice and rest model (back-to-backs included), and each opponent's tilt toward forwards or defencemen (points and shots allowed by position vs league, shrunk).

Goalie starts and lines: FORGE's per-candidate goalie contract for each team-game it projected gives each goalie his own start probability, "if he starts" line and unconditional values (counts assume no relief appearances); a teammate's line never stands in, and last-10 start shares are not start probabilities, so they are not used.
13 goalies are not among FORGE's start candidates for 13 team-games, so their start chance is unknown; only a line of their own, where FORGE has one, is kept as their "if he starts" line.

Goalie wins: each goalie's credited Win from the contract (if he starts; unconditional with his modelled relief share), recomputed with FORGE's win populations when news changes start chances; the team's win probability is served apart and never multiplied into a goalie's Win.

Goalie losses: regulation L and OT/SO L are unknown (no fitted overtime split, and the provider's L/OTL mapping is unverified), so totals that score them read unknown; L is never 1 − W, which would count overtime losses and no-decisions as losses.
Goalie news (IFTTT, accepted automatically): 0 confirmed, 0 likely or projected (start chance at least 80% / 65%), 0 ruled out.

Penalty kill not modelled for 0 skaters' lineup lines (written before FORGE's penalty-kill bucket, or for a team whose penalty-kill time FORGE could not model) and for every FORGE reserve line: their goals, assists, points and shots count even strength over all time outside the power play, at even-strength rates.

No FORGE line: 6 players (6 player-games) have no current FORGE line, so plans count 0 for them (a conservative assumption, not a zero chance); a player's last FORGE line, where one exists, is kept as his "if he plays" line and never counts.

FORGE reserve lines: 101 skaters outside FORGE's projected lineup carry an "if he dresses" line (101 player-games); dressing counts only when accepted news confirms it, otherwise plans count 0 and say why. 13 goalie-games use an "if he starts" line with an unknown start chance.
Only issued unconditional game forecasts are used. Conditional-only, missing, or out-of-horizon statistics are unknown, not zero.
Ownership is not league availability; missing or older than three days is unknown.
Recent scoring uses available game logs before the previous day; projection incorporation is unknown and no form bonus is added.
